schema.name: admins
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `admins` (
  `id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `email` varchar(254) NOT NULL,
  `password_hash` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `session_token` char(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `expires_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `email` (`email`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=2 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_uca1400_ai_ci

schema.name: contact_interactions
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `contact_interactions` (
  `id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `contact_message_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `interaction_type` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  `note` text NOT NULL,
  `interaction_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `contact_interactions_message_time` (`contact_message_id`,`interaction_at`),
  CONSTRAINT `contact_interactions_message_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`contact_message_id`) REFERENCES `contact_messages` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=4 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_uca1400_ai_ci

schema.name: contact_messages
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `contact_messages` (
  `id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(120) NOT NULL,
  `address` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `city` varchar(120) DEFAULT NULL,
  `state` varchar(120) DEFAULT NULL,
  `postal_code` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `email` varchar(254) NOT NULL,
  `mobile` varchar(30) DEFAULT NULL,
  `subject` varchar(160) NOT NULL,
  `message` text NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new',
  `admin_notes` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_contacted_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(),
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp() ON UPDATE current_timestamp(),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=3 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_uca1400_ai_ci

schema.name: donations
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `donations` (
  `id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `donor_name` varchar(120) NOT NULL,
  `donor_email` varchar(254) NOT NULL,
  `donor_mobile` varchar(30) DEFAULT NULL,
  `amount` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `currency` char(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INR',
  `razorpay_order_id` varchar(80) DEFAULT NULL,
  `razorpay_payment_id` varchar(80) DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` enum('created','failed','paid') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'created',
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(),
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp() ON UPDATE current_timestamp(),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `razorpay_order_id` (`razorpay_order_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `razorpay_payment_id` (`razorpay_payment_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_uca1400_ai_ci

schema.name: gallery_items
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `gallery_items` (
  `id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `title` varchar(160) NOT NULL,
  `description` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `image_path` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `event_date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `display_order` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `active` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(),
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp() ON UPDATE current_timestamp(),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=4 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_uca1400_ai_ci

schema.name: members
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `members` (
  `id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(120) NOT NULL,
  `designation` varchar(80) NOT NULL,
  `bio` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `photo_path` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `display_order` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `active` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(),
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp() ON UPDATE current_timestamp(),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=8 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_uca1400_ai_ci

schema.name: organization_settings
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `organization_settings` (
  `id` tinyint(3) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `organization_name` varchar(160) NOT NULL,
  `tagline` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `short_description` varchar(1000) DEFAULT NULL,
  `address` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `city` varchar(120) DEFAULT NULL,
  `state` varchar(120) DEFAULT NULL,
  `postal_code` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `primary_email` varchar(254) NOT NULL,
  `secondary_email` varchar(254) DEFAULT NULL,
  `primary_phone` varchar(30) NOT NULL,
  `secondary_phone` varchar(30) DEFAULT NULL,
  `whatsapp_number` varchar(30) DEFAULT NULL,
  `facebook_url` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `instagram_url` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `youtube_url` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `linkedin_url` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `google_maps_url` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `website_url` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(),
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp() ON UPDATE current_timestamp(),
  `threads_url` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `x_url` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_uca1400_ai_ci

schema.name: programs
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `programs` (
  `id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `title` varchar(160) NOT NULL,
  `short_description` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `description` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `image_path` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `location` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `start_date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `end_date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` varchar(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'upcoming',
  `display_order` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `active` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(),
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp() ON UPDATE current_timestamp(),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `programs_public_order` (`active`,`display_order`,`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=6 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_uca1400_ai_ci

schema.name: webhook_events
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `webhook_events` (
  `id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `provider` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `event_id` varchar(160) NOT NULL,
  `event_type` varchar(80) NOT NULL,
  `payload_hash` char(64) NOT NULL,
  `processed_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `webhook_identity` (`provider`,`event_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_uca1400_ai_ci
